usg.text: Phyrexia is the artificial realm of Yawgmoth, reached when he and the Thran exiles, saved through Phyresis, flee to it after being forced out of the Thran Empire.

In Urza's Saga, Urza dares to attack Phyrexia, and he and Xantcha blast a hole down to the Fourth Sphere before Yawgmoth drives them off by invading Urza's mind and driving him further insane, a moment remembered in [[The Fourth Sphere]].
Phyrexia only slowly retaliates, and when Rebbec seals the portal to Phyrexia, Yawgmoth is locked out for millennia.

nem.text: In Nemesis, Phyrexia reaches into Rath, choosing Crovax to take Volrath's place and bestowing new powers on him.
Crovax is taken to Phyrexia, where Kirril shapes him into Volrath's successor, while Rath's rebels unite in Eladamri's name to break free of its tyranny.
Phyrexia also claims Belbe: Avila's former lover poisons her and delivers her body there, and Abcal-dro rebuilds her as a cyborg and implants the Eye of Yawgmoth.

inv.text: In Invasion, the hordes of Phyrexia pour into Dominaria and the world looks to Urza for defense, and Rath's legions arrive through the Rathi Overlay.
Urza leads the Nine Titans in a counterattack on Phyrexia, but Tevesh Szat betrays and kills Daria, and Urza kills him, sealing him in a soul bomb.

Then Urza falls under Yawgmoth's influence, dismantles the master soul bomb and slays Taysir, and the four remaining Titans detonate the soul bombs by hand, shattering the first seven spheres of Phyrexia.
Guff reveals that Yawgmoth had already left for Dominaria through a portal, and the Keldon Twilight sweeps the Phyrexian armies away in an absolute loss.

pls.text: In Planeshift, nine planeswalkers seek the annihilation of Phyrexia to save Dominaria, and they attack it with soul bombs.
Deep in Yawgmoth's realm, Urza sees a vision of his brother Mishra, and Yawgmoth shows him the tortured Mishra before Urza prostrates himself and Gerrard pledges allegiance as well.

apc.text: In Apocalypse, Freyalise buys the planeswalkers time by clearing a path through the misshapen hell of Phyrexia, and she sets a bomb against Yawgmoth.
Yawgmoth sets Gerrard and Urza to fight in an arena, and Gerrard beheads Urza, rejects Yawgmoth's reward and sees through a false Hanna before he is flung out of Phyrexia.
The remaining Titans set off the last soul bomb, gutting Phyrexia, but Yawgmoth has already left and arrives on Dominaria as a death cloud.

tsb.text: Phyrexia is the destination the Brotherhood of Gix hoped Gix's hand would point to.

som.text: In Scars of Mirrodin, Phyrexia, defeated on Dominaria when Karn obliterated Yawgmoth, secretly begins rebuilding itself on Mirrodin after the oil plants a virus there, and it invades and tarnishes the plane.
Phyrexian oil passes its contagion to anything it touches, and Mirrans soon meet horrible amalgams of necrotic flesh and corroded metal.
Geth makes a deal with the Phyrexians, who graft his undead head onto a new metal body, while the Mirrans turn to darksteel to aid their fight.
Phyrexia, devastated by Urza's allies, endures through its oil and splits into five factions led by Praetors.

mbs.text: In Mirrodin Besieged, the Phyrexian assault on Mirrodin intensifies while the Mirran resistance rallies, and war rages with cries of battle everywhere.
The Mirrans recruit constructs, golems and Myr to the cause, and their Titan Forge manufactures colossal golems as a secret weapon.
Phyrexia spreads unevenly, with black and green falling quickly, then blue and a little white, while red resists, and Glissa is Phyrexianized and turns traitor.

nph.text: In New Phyrexia, Phyrexia grows rapidly after exposure to the planar core's mana and divides into five mana-aligned factions.
Glissa argues for striking the surface immediately, and the Sylvok are hit hardest, with over half killed in the first wave after her arrival.
In the end the Phyrexians defeat the Mirrans and take control of Mirrodin, turning it into New Phyrexia.

m12.text: In Magic 2012, Mirrodin has come under new management as Phyrexia takes over, and visiting planeswalkers must conclude for themselves that the Mirrans have lost the plane.

cmr.text: In Commander Legends, Sheoldred predicts that many worlds will bow to Phyrexia, with Mirrodin merely the first.

mbc.text: Phyrexia appears as the realm Lyna holds accountable for its deeds.
